From the MathWorld Fibonacci Number page (https://mathworld.wolfram.com/FibonacciNumber.html):

• Recurrence (as displayed):
  F_n = F_{n-1} + F_{n-2}

• Initial conditions (as displayed):
  F_0 = 0, F_1 = 1

• First eight positive-index Fibonacci numbers (F_1 through F_8, as given on the page):
  F_1 = 1,
  F_2 = 1,
  F_3 = 2,
  F_4 = 3,
  F_5 = 5,
  F_6 = 8,
  F_7 = 13,
  F_8 = 21.

  (These correspond to the sentence: “The Fibonacci numbers for n = 1, 2, ... are 1, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, 13, 21, ... (OEIS A000045).”)

• Linked OEIS identifier for the Fibonacci sequence (as displayed and linked):
  A000045
